title.en: Parameter experiment with visible cause and reset

summary: Connect a small set of controls to meaningful model changes and repeatable observations.
objective: Connect a small set of controls to meaningful model changes and repeatable observations.
example_prompts: Use parameter experiment with visible cause and reset for the scene, preserving its model and user controls.

principles: Expose parameters whose consequences can actually be seen or measured in the scene.
Changing appearance is not a substitute for changing a physical or mathematical parameter.
implementation: State whether parameter edits apply immediately, on restart or at the next committed step.
Keep units and valid ranges near the control; show derived output from the same state.
Preserve a reproducible initial condition or recorded seed when comparisons require it.
observable_checks: Changing a control updates its actual model parameter and the corresponding derived output.
Reset restores the documented initial condition without stale trajectories or measurements.

creative_affordances: Adapt the layout, visual treatment and timing to the task; these are reusable design proposals, not mandatory templates.
known_limits: Authored interaction/presentation guidance; no new scientific claim, accessibility certification or runtime verification is asserted.
